input.prompt: Kling first-last-frame motion with generated audio. Continue from Shot 06 to Shot 07 as one continuous interior lift movement. The same dark industrial scissor lift is now inside the fixed matte-black ovoid vessel. The lift rises straight upward in place with no horizontal travel, no sliding, no swinging, and no detaching. The camera behaves like a restrained passenger viewpoint on or just behind the lift: it slowly tilts and aligns upward toward the tall vertical interior while the exterior aperture leaves the frame naturally because of the camera tilt and ascent. The UFO interior is a fixed, extremely tall black shaft with rough striated matte surfaces; walls do not move toward the camera, do not warp, and do not turn into panels. The distant pale ceiling/contact point grows only slightly and remains far above, preserving the enormous vessel scale. The four pale grey-suited researchers stay on the lift platform, bracing subtly against the rails; nobody walks, steps off, jumps, teleports, duplicates, floats, or changes costume. Preserve black rails, dark cases, muted backpacks, matte black hull texture, low contrast, fog, desaturated green-grey and blue-grey 35mm film grade, and crushed readable blacks. No new lights switch on, no orange/red color shift, no portal, no glowing sci-fi machinery, no corridor. Audio is minimal but present: low wind pressure, deep interior air resonance, faint smooth lift motor, soft rail vibration, and a quiet gravitational hum only; no music, no dialogue, no gunshots, no clicks, no metallic hits, no sharp transients.
